description: This file defines an Angular component named CounterControlsComponent that provides UI buttons for controlling a counter, emitting events for increment, decrement, reset, and asynchronous increment actions.

classes.name: CounterControlsComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that emits events for counter control buttons (increment, decrement, reset, async increment).

methods.name: increment
methods.description: EventEmitter<void> that emits an event when the increment button is clicked.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: EventEmitter<void> that emits an event when the decrement button is clicked.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: EventEmitter<void> that emits an event when the reset button is clicked.

methods.name: incrementAsync
methods.description: EventEmitter<void> that emits an event when the asynchronous increment button is clicked.
